{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash

# Flux batch script
#
# This is a self-submitting Flux script: run it directly (e.g., `./serene.flux.sh`).
# It will submit itself to Flux with the translated resource requests.

# Translated resources from Slurm:
#   --nodes=1         -> -N 1
#   --time=24:00:00   -> -t 24h
#   --gres=gpu:4      -> -g 4
JOBID=$(flux batch -N 1 -n 1 -g 4 -t 24h --wrap "bash $0 __flux_inner")

echo "Submitted Flux job: $JOBID"

if [ "${1:-}" = "__flux_inner" ]; then
  # NOTE: Slurm --job-name=serene not translated.
  # Performance/ops implication: job identification may be less convenient; runtime performance is unaffected.

  # NOTE: Slurm --output/--error use %J expansion (jobid) which Flux does not provide portably.
  # Performance implication: none; operational implication: log filenames may not be unique unless you add uniqueness.

  # NOTE: Slurm --gpus-per-node=4 not translated (already implied by -N 1 and -g 4 for this job).
  # Performance implication: none.

  # NOTE: Slurm --mail-type/--mail-user not translated.
  # Performance implication: none; operational implication: no email notifications.

  module load python/3.8.6
  module load cuda/10.1
  module load tensorflow/2.3.1

  CONFIG_PATH="$HOME/SegU-Net/config"

  source "$HOME/nnevn/bin/activate"

  flux run -n 1 -g 4 python segUNet.py "$CONFIG_PATH/net_Unet_lc.ini"

  deactivate
fi
"
}
